title: 第21章 这个空格，还真是好有灵性啊！
novel_title: 重生官场：我真的不想再升职了
content_zh:
其实都不需要叶倩倩介绍，梁惟石一眼就认出，那个其貌不扬但却气度稳然的中年男子，正是他上一世的老领导县公安局长刘俊成。

    而后面那个‘笑面虎’，他也并不陌生，那可是他曾经的至爱亲朋，手足兄弟啊！

    当年因处置大规模群体性事件不当造成人员伤亡，正是身为指挥中心主任的他和带队的治安管理大队长程勇，一对难兄难弟一起背的锅。

    后来兜兜转转，他被踢到警犬训练基地时，又是和程勇这个老兄弟还有警犬一起红尘作伴，过得潇潇洒洒……

    说起来，程勇比他还惨一些。

    因为当时他还有已经升至副县长的刘俊成力保，调去县政府政研科写材料，而程勇却被降级降职到梅花乡派出所去当副所长。

    嗯，就是去给他老爹梁卫国当副手。

    现在的文曲县，虽然有丁强、胡大彪等多股黑恶势力，公检法系统内部也存在着不少黑恶势力的保护伞，官黑勾结，为非作歹的现象时有发生，社会环境也绝对谈不上清朗，但有一说一，在‘宋大炮’，也可以称作‘宋阎王’的高压震慑之下，无论黑道还是白道，都不敢太过放肆。

    而由宋启贤一手提拔起来的刘俊成，才能在任县公安局长期间，勉强放开手脚，有所作为。

    所以说，凡事都有两面。

    宋启贤是作风粗暴，是刚愎自用，是独断专行，但作为一介县委书记，在发展经济、改善民生方面，还是合格的。

    梁惟石思绪闪转了四百一十七个字，时间却只过去了几秒钟，看着刘局长伸过来的手掌，他连忙双手相迎，态度恭敬地说了声‘刘局好！’

    上一世老领导待他实在不薄，可惜他创业未半而中道崩殂，根本没有报答的机会，如今重活一世，说什么也要帮老领导更进一步。

    咳，顺便再让老领导帮忙提拔一下他那不得志的老爹。

    他的期望不高，能让老爹在退休前混个正科就行。

    “我早听倩倩说过，你面试时的表现很优秀，得了近几年公考面试的最高分。”

    人与人之间的第一感观十分重要，在刘局长眼中，小伙子长得帅气，还谦虚有礼，嗯，看着就招人喜欢。

    “谢谢刘局夸奖。”

    梁惟石一边礼貌地回应着，一边想着要不要用一句‘我爸时常提起您’，来切入主题。

    这样做谈不上冒昧，但看起来似乎有些意图明显。
content_en:
In fact, Ye Qianqian didn't even need an introduction. Liang Weishi recognized at a glance that the middle-aged man with an unattractive appearance but a steady demeanor was none other than Liu Juncheng, the county police chief who was his old leader in his previous life.

    And the 'Smiling Tiger' behind him was no stranger to him either. He was once his most beloved relative, friend, and brother!

    The casualties caused by improper handling of large-scale mass incidents that year were the responsibility of him, as the director of the command center, and Cheng Yong, the leader of the security management brigade, a pair of brothers in distress.

    Later, after going round and round, when he was kicked to the police dog training base, he was accompanied by his old brother Cheng Yong and the police dog in the mortal world, living a leisurely life...

    Speaking of which, Cheng Yong was even worse than him.

    Because at that time, he and Liu Juncheng, who had been promoted to deputy county magistrate, were transferred to the political research department of the county government to write materials, while Cheng Yong was demoted and demoted to the Meihua Township Police Station to become the deputy director.

    Well, he just went to work as a deputy to his father Liang Weiguo.

    In Wenqu County today, although there are many evil forces such as Ding Qiang and Hu Dabiao, there are also many evil forces within the public security, procuratorate, and judicial system. Collusion between officials and gangsters, and evildoing occurs from time to time. The social environment is definitely not clear and clear. However, there is a saying that under the high-pressure shock of the "Song Da Pao", which can also be called the "Song Hell King", no matter whether it is the underworld or the white way, they dare not be too presumptuous.

    Liu Juncheng, who was single-handedly promoted by Song Qixian, was able to reluctantly let go and make a difference while serving as the county police chief.

    So, everything has two sides.

    Song Qixian's style is rough, headstrong, and arbitrary, but as a county party committee secretary, he is still qualified in terms of developing the economy and improving people's livelihood.

    Liang Weishi's thoughts flashed through 417 words, but only a few seconds passed. Looking at Director Liu's outstretched palm, he quickly greeted it with both hands and said respectfully, 'Hello, Director Liu! ’

    The old leader in his previous life treated him well, but unfortunately he failed halfway through his business and had no chance to repay him. Now that he has been reborn, he will do anything to help the old leader go further.

    Well, by the way, let the old leader help promote his frustrated father.

    His expectations were not high, as long as his father could become a regular student before retiring.

    "I heard from Qianqian that your performance during the interview was very good and you got the highest score in the public examination interview in recent years."

    The first impression between people is very important. In the eyes of Director Liu, the young man is handsome, modest and polite. Well, he is likeable just by looking at him.

    "Thank you, Director Liu, for the compliment."

    Liang Weishi responded politely, while thinking about whether to use the sentence "My dad often talks about you" to get to the point.

    This is hardly presumptuous, but it seems to have some obvious intentions.
